name: slide-library
release_notes: Add explicit export and restore commands for portable PowerPoint profiles and archived setups.
Validate curated content before saving, restore failed batches and retain previous record versions.
Require traceable portrait assignments and prevent hidden slides from entering reusable content.
Validate design references, finite layout geometry and declared assets; support POTX references.
Include cited-source filenames and fingerprints in portable profiles without bundling raw sources.
Preserve existing citations during text recapture and revoke outdated source permissions after scope changes.
Allow independent curation while unrelated records need repair; harden import recovery and export paths.
